Overview.Name: Anakatala Swaroopa
Overview.Goal: Health, stability, strength through simple egg-based meals with gentle digestion, low-salt cooking for blood pressure, and protein priority to improve strength and support joint function.

Meal_1_Breakfast: 2 to 3 whole eggs pan fried in ghee + cooked vegetables
OR Vegetable omelette with onions, tomatoes and spinach
Meal_2_Lunch: 2 to 3 boiled or pan fried eggs + 1 small cup rice + cooked vegetables
OR Egg curry (less spice) + rice + leafy vegetables
OR Paneer (100 to 150g) cooked in butter or ghee + vegetables + small portion rice
Meal_3_Dinner: OR Paneer curry + small bowl rice
OR Vegetable plate + curd + boiled eggs

Notes_and_Tips: Keep meals less spicy to avoid vertigo triggers and reduce inflammation.
Use ghee or butter for cooking. Avoid all seed oils.
Prioritise eggs and paneer in each meal to support muscle strength and reduce joint pain.
For hypertension: reduce packaged foods, papads, pickles and any high-salt dishes.
Eat slowly and stop at comfortable fullness since you already manage desserts well.
Since steps are below 5k, add small walks after meals to improve blood pressure and digestion.
Yoga supports balance and stability. Add gentle stretching for knee and back pain.
Consistency is more important than variety for your goals. Keep meals simple and repeatable.
Drink 2.5L water per day for proper hydration and blood pressure management.
Salt intake: Keep on the lower side for blood pressure control.
